description: React component for the main index route of a to-do list application, managing tasks with state hooks, loading and saving items via utility functions, and rendering UI with filtering capabilities.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines metadata for the page, including title and description.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Main React component for the to-do list, handling task CRUD operations and UI rendering.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Adds a new task to the list after validating input.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task from the list.

methods.name: onInputKeyDown
methods.description: Handles pressing Enter to add a task.
